label: Uptime Kuma
description: Monitors and their status, status pages
agentGuide: Two doors. GET /metrics (Prometheus text) lists every monitor: monitor_status{monitor_name=...,monitor_url=...} is 1 up, 0 down, 2 pending, 3 maintenance; monitor_response_time in ms; monitor_cert_days_remaining. Read the lines, do not ask for them twice in a minute. Status pages, public: GET /api/status-page/<slug> (publicGroupList with monitors) and GET /api/status-page/heartbeat/<slug> (heartbeatList by monitor id, uptimeList). A badge: GET /api/badge/<monitor id>/status. Nothing can be changed through this API: monitors are edited in Uptime Kuma's interface.
